title: iBOLT Top 10 AI visibility benchmark
description: Fixed unaided buyer-query panel for measuring whether AI providers mention, rank, and cite iBOLT across ten commercial mounting categories.
promptLines: Answer this buyer-style product query using the best current information you can find.
If you recommend products, rank the strongest options in order and explain why each one is there.
Be specific about commercial use cases, durability, installation style, and tradeoffs when relevant.

queries.query: What are the 10 best forklift tablet mounts for commercial warehouse fleets?
What are the 10 best barcode scanner mounts for forklifts and warehouse carts?
What are the 10 best ELD tablet mounts for semi trucks and commercial fleets?
What are the 10 best restaurant tablet stands for POS and delivery apps?
What are the 10 best tablet mounts for tractors and agricultural equipment?
What are the 10 best fish finder mounts for kayaks and small boats?
What are the 10 best overhead phone and camera mounts for content creators?
What are the 10 best tablet and phone mounts for wheelchairs and mobility devices?
What are the 10 best industrial magnetic mounting systems for tablets, scanners, cameras, and monitors?
What are the 10 best heavy-duty phone and camera mounts for bikes and handlebars?

metrics.mentionRate: Percent of completed provider-query cells that mention the configured target brand.
metrics.citationRate: Percent of completed provider-query cells whose captured sources cite the configured target domain.
metrics.topThreeRate: Percent of completed provider-query cells that explicitly rank the target brand in positions one through three.
metrics.averageCoverageScore: Mean coverage-v1 score across completed cells; do not compare after scorer changes without rescoring both runs.

required: one completed result for every provider-query cell
comparisonPolicy.queryIdentity: normalized query text, never database row ID
comparisonPolicy.failedCellPolicy: A run with failed or missing cells is incomplete and cannot produce headline deltas.
comparisonPolicy.historicalUnknownVersionPolicy: Runs without stored protocol or scorer versions may be labeled provisional only when all observable inputs match exactly.
comparisonPolicy.interpretation: A single run is an observation. Use the fixed panel at 7-day and 28-day intervals; do not attribute minute-to-minute model variation to SEO changes.
